name: Mias
source:
"Yay! Food Food~! What kind of flavors do human foods have? I'll enjoy this!"

A canary that was attacked by wild animals and collapsed inside the grounds of Rozum castle. There he was saved by the princess Julia.
Even after his injuries healed and he was able to fly again he stayed by Julia's side.
He's naive, but always making a fuss, he easily opens up to anyone.
His favorite things are singing and boiled eggs.
